notes_for_editor: Two independent sources agree on 1936 and 100 feet. The 2005 PDF text runs in columns, so the quotes are single lines. The standing status comes from the FFLA list, which is undated. No staffing record was found, and no source says whether visitors may climb the tower. The FWS refuge page (fws.gov/refuge/lostwood) was checked by keyword and mentions no tower. The brief had no agency; USFWS was taken from the 2005 brochure. No NHLR or FFLOS detail record turned up in search.
